# Stata reference fixtures

`panel.csv` and `gravity.csv` contain the synthetic panels used for the
Stata comparison. The package dataset `gravity` is a separate PPML simulation
generated by `data-raw/generate_gravity.R`. `stata.csv` retains the Stata columns
from the comparison results. The estimates and standard errors are saved at full
precision. Rows within each aggregation retain Stata's coefficient order.

The original comparison used seed `20261009`, Stata 19.5, jwdid 2.201,
jwdid_estat 2.2, ppmlhdfe 2.3.4 and reghdfe 6.14.1. The remaining environment
details are in `validation_environment.txt`; pinned source commits and hashes
are in `source_versions.json`.

The default panel command is:

```stata
jwdid y x, ivar(id) tvar(t) gvar(g) never method(ppmlhdfe)
```

The `ppml_never` case omits `x`; `ppml_notyet` omits `never`. In
`ppml_no_never`, zero cohorts become 8 and `never` is omitted. The anticipation
case adds `anticipation(2)`. The gravity command, using the fixture's
column names, is:

```stata
jwdid trade, ivar(id) tvar(year) gvar(g) never method(ppmlhdfe) fevar(exporter#year importer#year)
```

Each fitted model uses `estat simple`, `estat group`, `estat calendar`,
`estat event` and `estat attgt`, on the default response scale and with
`predict(xb)`. The `window` and `cwindow` cases use only `estat event`, with
`window(-2 3)` and `cwindow(-2 3)` respectively.
